title: Hanasato Minori — Passionate Talk!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See you next time, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great stream, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That went so well!
Also, Shizuku, congratulations on getting your design chosen!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I still can't believe mine got chosen.
Especially considering how lovely your designs were.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, we all worked really hard on them just for today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But in the end, Shizuku, I genuinely felt that your design's the one that would propel us forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
I can't wait to put on a show while wearing your outfit!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait either.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At the same time, I don't want your wonderful ideas you came up with to go to waste. That'd be too much of a shame, don't you think...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Some of our viewers even said so themselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get how you feel...
If I'm gonna be honest, one outfit probably won't be enough...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If that's the case, why don't we keep working on our outfits with our fans alongside Shizuku's...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hers will obviously take priority, but it'll be a good opportunity for us to think beyond the present.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's a great idea! I'm 100%... No, 1000% for it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That way, I won't have to give up on my dream of Haruka wearing the angel outfit I designed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wow...
You just can't help yourself, can you...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Times like these, it's best to look at things from a fan's perspective!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree!
It's important to think about how they'll see us in these outfits.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also... Something's been on my mind the entire time I was designing my outfit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Like another idea?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This time, we had a chance to see what our fans thought when it came to our designs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I thought it'd be nice if we could have them design some stuff for us too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because I'm sure there are others out there who are thinking, “I want to see them sing and dance while wearing the outfit I designed!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Minori might be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I think it's a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
How about you, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree with them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They might be able to come up with a great design or find a way to present us in an even better light because they'll be seeing things from their perspective.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Haruka, you really understand...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, we can't always be asking them for favors like we did during our event the other day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're asking for their help, which means we should be compensating them accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's right.
I mean, we got together what we could for our last event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's not exactly a fair trade considering how much they all had to work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're trying to spread and inspire hope in others, so we need to buckle up when it comes to these kinds of things...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. We may not be able to do so now, but it is something we'll have to seriously consider.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I was so happy when I heard we'd be putting on our own event and designing our own outfits...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But we can't keep waiting for them to throw a gift in our lap.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So... Does that mean we shouldn't have them make our outfits for us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You said it yourself, Minori.
It'll be a fun experience for them and a dream come true for some.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Hearing design ideas from them isn't necessarily a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We just need to make sure everyone's compensated for their work once it's all said and done.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we'll want to discuss a matter such as this sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. We can set aside some time for that when we get to that bridge.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that also means we'll need to work out all the details for Shizuku's design.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially if we want to have them for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So ask us for help if you ever think you need it, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I will.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Compensation, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Those three are so professional.
It's like they know exactly what do to and where to be careful...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even if it's little by little, I want to learn how to think like that too!)
